locations.relevance: Singleton H regions use fixed control; X assigns K to ordinary nodes and S to H nodes
Fixed-region nodes are excluded from description parameter ownership
Memory descriptions are prepared, but fixed regions bypass describe and regional score allocation
Memory finish consumes context and fixed control
Summary recurrence and read projection feed the returned description
Summary state is saved, while finish context contains u, times, owners, SSD reads, values and gate
Full content uses SSD reads/values/gate, output projection and FFN, not summary/read description projections
NodeLinear weight/left/right are ordinary nn.Parameters, with no explicit freezing here
Default local clock resolution from graph period and timing

limitations: The result stores changed tensor counts but no per-parameter changed/unchanged names or initial hashes; do not present the identity of all six unchanged tensors as an independently recorded per-parameter difference.
The named None-gradient list describes only the final training update. No per-step parameter-gradient history was recorded.
The exact-match private-state recovery checks state preservation, not causal usefulness of each saved component.
A parameter tensor changing under AdamW can include weight decay; it does not establish useful learning or nonzero loss gradient for every element.
This static coverage explanation does not establish an architecture-wide trainability defect or an implementation error.
Clock values and structural loss disconnection are source-derived inferences; no new runtime capture or intervention was performed.

review_scope: Read-only review of terminal result, step records and frozen source; no model execution or numerical diagnosis

static_inferences.claim: For this X-singleton configuration, every S-memory node is an H node whose regional control is fixed; S summary/read description projections therefore have no path to the language loss through regional allocation.

static_inferences.basis: parameter update observations and frozen forward dataflow; no per-parameter initial/final hash comparison is available
static_inferences.claim: The six final-step None-gradient parameters are structurally bypassed description projections, consistent with the six tensors that did not change over the run. This is not evidence that the SSD recurrent matrix/output/FFN paths failed to train.

No explicit requires_grad freezing is present in the reviewed parameter construction or pilot training path. The structural disconnection remains when extending the same singleton recipe or TBPTT horizon.

static_inferences.basis: config.py:36-41; task and work records; worker StreamBatch and train_update
static_inferences.claim: With observed period=4 and default clock fields, position_period=4, kv_window=512 logical ticks, short_decay=ln(2)/32, and ssd_stride=1. Each L64 update spans 256 Timed ticks; four contiguous windows span 256 input tokens / 1024 ticks before reset, with gradients detached between updates.
